description: You are an IT operations engineer responsible for onboarding two new commercial tenants onto the building's shared Emoncms energy monitoring server at http://localhost (admin/admin). Each tenant must have isolated visibility into only their own energy data. Create a separate Emoncms user account for each tenant: username 'tenant_a' with email tenant_a@building.local, and username 'tenant_b' with email tenant_b@building.local. After creating each account, retrieve their write API keys and use them to post energy consumption data: post readings for inputs 'hvac_w' and 'lighting_w' under node 'floor_a' using tenant_a's API key, and post readings for inputs 'hvac_w' and 'lighting_w' under node 'floor_b' using tenant_b's API key. Configure each tenant's input process lists to log data to named feeds, and create a dedicated monitoring dashboard for each tenant: 'Tenant A Energy' for tenant_a and 'Tenant B Energy' for tenant_b.
